name: 46703 · Angola, IN
findings: ZIP 46703 (Angola) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46703 (Angola) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46703 (Angola) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
